title: The Subnormality of $\mathbb K$-Homogeneous Multiplication Operators on Bounded Symmetric Domains
summary: Let $Ω=G/\mathbb K$ be an irreducible bounded symmetric domain of rank $r$ and dimension $d.$ In this paper, we study the joint subnormality of $d$-tuple of multiplication operators induced by the coordinate functions on reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces of holomorphic functions on $Ω$ determined by $\mathbb K$-invariant kernels. We introduce the notion of contractive $d$-tuple associated with $Ω$ and prove that the weighted Bergman shifts on $Ω$ are contractive $d$-tuple precisely when they are jointly subnormal.
